name: record-layout
title: Record Layout
description: A record page: the main column and one side panel of stacked, folding sections — docked from 1200px, floating below, a sheet on a phone.

meta.whenToUse: A record page (a task, a meeting, a page, a customer): the work in one main column, and its reference material (Details, Transcript, Files, Versions, Activity, Ask) in one side panel opened from the strip.
meta.whenNotToUse: A list page — a row opens in Peek; a page with no record (a dashboard) — use ShellPage alone.
